title: Checks for ignored tests without messages.
summary: The reason for ignoring the test may not be obvious. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of _ in patterns of type ().
summary: Matching with () explicitly instead of _ outlines the fact that the pattern contains no data. Also it would detect a type change that _ would ignore. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.
